verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a system-on-chip, and telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a software or OS-level privacy control rather than a property of the processor itself. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip ships any telemetry or opt-out capability. The story is therefore a category error for this product type, not a missing feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
